title: malus baccata f. zumi
intro: Malus baccata f. zumi, commonly known as the Chinese crabapple or Zumi, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the mountainous regions of China. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as lowering cholesterol levels, reducing inflammation, and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Malus baccata f. zumi include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties, which are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Malus baccata f. zumi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
